metadata.description: CloudBackend PaaS and XIOS/3 developer tooling for Claude: the published skills, five workflow agents, the documentation, build and tenant servers inside the plugin, and the per-tenant deploy connector.

plugins.name: cloudbackend
plugins.description: Build on CloudBackend PaaS with XIOS/3: five skills (the launch path from an idea to paying customers with its build phases, XIOS/3 markup and design, the Singularity database, the REST API, the native SDKs), three build agents, and the documentation, build and tenant servers running on your computer (the tenant server signs you in in your browser and deploys).
